## Character pack checklist

- [ ] I kept character behavior data-only and used safe relative asset paths.
- [ ] I checked the manifest, thumbnail, PNG atlases, license, and notice records.
- [ ] I ran the focused package test and build for every character I changed.
- [ ] I added a Changeset for every file change under every affected `packages/pack-*` workspace.
- [ ] I deliberately chose `patch` for compatible fixes or tuning, `minor` for meaningful backwards-compatible additions or substantial creative updates, or `major` for a breaking replacement or removal. I explained non-patch choices above.
- [ ] A new pack uses an unused identifier and npm package name, and its art, name, and attribution do not overwrite or claim someone else's work.
- [ ] I ran `npm run check`.
